# MultiSourceTaskonomy

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A framework for mapping and transferring knowledge across multiple source tasks to improve learning efficiency on a target task, extending single-source taskonomy. Enables cross-domain task reuse in TCC/iNEST systems, allowing in-network neuromorphic processors to leverage diverse prior experiences for adaptive routing and computation.
